描述_EN: another use it might have had is that of a 'meditation chair', a term often mentioned in 16th-century texts. it is made of the expensive huali wood, and it would have served as a dining chair. this armchair has a straight back instead of a curved one.
描述_ZN: 它的另一个用途可能是 "冥想椅"，这个词在16世纪的文献中经常被提及。 它是由昂贵的花梨木制成的，它可以作为餐椅使用。 这个扶手椅的椅背是直的而不是弯的。
